angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop lean (Hoop G) as a day-3 film flag; frozen 2026 test of Hoop G vs a held-out pick + role forecast of career pressure rate, leave-one-class-out over 2023-25, drill measures year-standardized; baselines pick + role and a shrunk full no-tracking model (pick, role, weight, NGS, 10-yd split, 3-cone); new rush-level drill-to-play mechanism test
metric_name: Hoop G: speed^2 / turn radius at a lineman's hardest half-second of the Run-the-Hoop figure-eight, in g, z within Combine year
headline_number: +2.3 pressures per 450-rush season per sd [95%: 0.7, 4.0], n=77, held-out classes; best-of-six one-sided p = 0.019. Measure re-chosen inside each fold: R2 0.10 -> 0.16 (gain 95% -0.30 to 0.21), shuffle p = 0.020, Hoop G picked in 1 of 3 folds (a hoop measure in 3 of 3). Mechanism on 1,295 sampled rushes: own-rush lean x Hoop G +1.6 pressure points [0.0, 3.2]; hoop-tight rush x Hoop G +4.6 [1.5, 7.7]. Day 3 (n=47): rank corr 0.26 vs 0.01 for pick order; Brier 0.235 vs 0.299.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 25 cand 1 (8.51), applying the judges' top_changes. DS: best-of-six selection rerun inside each leave-one-class-out training fold, reported as a held-out R2 gain with bootstrap 95% CI and a shuffle p that reruns the whole selection; direct drill-to-play rush-level mixed models (rusher random intercept) on 1,295 random rushes, using self-normalized rush lean and tightness-matched hoop-tight rushes, each crossed with Hoop G, plus a rusher-cluster bootstrap; quantitative day-3 evaluation on all 47 men (pooled rank correlation and an out-of-class Brier score, 95% CIs) in place of the four anecdotal play-log verdicts; R2-gain interval for the wave-lean joint model; 5 new tests added to the multiplicity family (41). Football: stance (listed OLB), snap load (rushes per game) and club pass-rush environment added to the forecast; a short football explanation of why lean should produce pressure; the mechanism gap is now answered as 'Hoop G does not predict how often a man bends, it marks whose hardest bends end in pressure'; Table 2 ranks the 7 names the flag adds to pick order's top third, with a rule-based tape cue each; it says plainly that no 2026 Combine tracking exists yet, so no 2026 list. Writeup: plain scout-language title ('a film flag, not a board input') and lede, with no CI/p in the lede; the four bullets under Table 1 cut to two sentences with the detail in Table A1; the 0.36/0.14/0.05 chain dropped; 'draft order misses' removed. Viz: Fig 1 rebuilt as hoop lap vs NFL rushes for four of the added names on one yard and lean scale with a numeric strip; Fig 2 slimmed to 8 rows with a colour legend; new Fig 3 for the mechanism; Fig 4 shows the day-3 evaluation and the added names; every interval is 95%; A2 merged into A1.
open_risks: Nested selection keeps the R2 gain (0.06) but the interval is wide (-0.30 to 0.21, positive in about 44% of bootstraps) and Hoop G itself is chosen in only 1 of 3 folds
Mechanism interactions are new tests on about 17 random rushes per man; the own-lean x Hoop G interval reaches zero and the hoop-tight term depends on the 2x-radius definition
Day-3 ranking and Brier gains favour Hoop G, but their 95% intervals cross zero and the top-third hit counts tie at 9 of 15
Stance is a roster-listing proxy, snap load is partly an outcome, and the club environment is read only from other cohort linemen
No 2026 Combine tracking in the data, so the 2026 film list cannot be shown yet
